title: Deep Learning Approaches for Efficient and Accurate DNA Sequence Alignment using Large Language Models
description: This project presents a hybrid framework for DNA sequence alignment combining traditional methods with deep learning using DNABERT. The system analyzes sequences through two paths: identity-based alignment and embedding-based similarity. Results are compared to detect hidden relationships and generate a phylogenetic tree. The model was tested on two datasets (20 and 70 sequences) and achieved high performance (AUROC up to 0.95), showing improved accuracy over traditional methods.

title: Fan engagement and loyalty app for Saudi football clubs
description:
The project is a cross-platform digital ecosystem (mobile and web) specifically designed to tackle the issue of low stadium attendance in Saudi football. It unifies the entire fan journey into a single platform by integrating the following features:

Ticketing: Real-time seasonal ticket booking with an interactive stadium map and real-time seat locking.

Loyalty System: A gamified "Dynamic Points Algorithm" that rewards fans for match attendance, early arrival, and team victories.

Volunteer Opportunities: A dedicated module that allows fans to participate in club-organized volunteer events. Fans earn special loyalty points for their service, which can be accumulated and redeemed for exclusive rewards, such as official merchandise, free tickets, or partner discounts, providing a meaningful way to benefit from their contribution.

Gate Operations: A secure QR-based validation system for authenticated stadium entry.

Community & Partners: Centralized club news and a "Partner Portal" for local business offers and discounts

title: Jadwa AI: AI-Powered Business Feasibility Platform
description:
Jadwa AI is an intelligent web-based platform designed to help entrepreneurs evaluate business ideas before implementation. The system uses Machine Learning and AI technologies to analyze project feasibility based on budget, location, project type, duration, and market indicators.

It provides a feasibility score, smart recommendations, PDF reports, and a project re-analysis feature that allows users to compare previous and updated feasibility results. The system also supports Arabic/English and includes an interactive dashboard.

The platform was fully developed, tested, and deployed online using Django and Microsoft Azure.

title: AutoPent
description:
AutoPent is a web-based automated penetration testing tool designed to scan target URLs and identify potential security vulnerabilities efficiently. It minimizes manual effort and accelerates the security assessment process by providing clear, structured results.

The system supports multiple scanning modes (Safe, Fast, and Full) and includes key features such as link verification, secure HTTP handling, automated risk scoring, scan history tracking, and result comparison. It is developed باستخدام Python and Flask with an interactive web interface and database integration.

Experimental evaluation demonstrated that AutoPent effectively detects common vulnerabilities, maintains stable performance, and delivers a reliable, scalable solution for web security assessment.

description:

title: Deep Learning-Based 3D Reconstruction for Personalized Orthotic Models
description: Deep learning techniques have been widely developed to process 3D data directly from point clouds. It presents a comparative analysis of PointNet++, a Transformer-based reconstruction model, and a proposed hybrid framework that integrates both approaches for 3D reconstruction from imperfect point cloud data. The evaluation is conducted based on geometric accuracy, structural detail preservation, and surface quality. These findings highlight the complementary nature of local and global representations and support the selection of hybrid strategies for accurate and scalable medical 3D reconstruction.

title: SMART MIRROR: An Interactive Reflective Interface for Daily Information Management
description: This project involves designing and developing a Smart Mirror system that combines a two-way reflective surface with a digital display to show users real-time information such as time, weather, calendar events, and to-do lists. The motivation for this project comes from the growing reliance on multiple digital devices for daily information, which can be inconvenient during busy routines. The Smart Mirror aims to centralize key information into a single, easily accessible interface that boosts user productivity and convenience. The system uses a Raspberry Pi 5, a 15.6-inch HD display, a PIR motion sensor, and the MagicMirror framework to create a modular, customizable, and interactive experience. The smart mirror automatically turns on when it detects user presence and fetches live data via APIs to keep the information up to date. The project’s goals include creating an affordable, functional smart home device, improving user interaction, and assessing the feasibility of adding advanced features within the given time and budget limits. The proposed solution offers a practical, energy-efficient, and user-friendly smart device with potential for future upgrades.

title: AI-Based Phishing URL Detection
description: AI-Based Phishing URL Detection is a cybersecurity project that aims to identify malicious URLs using machine learning techniques. Two models, Random Forest and Gradient Boosting, were implemented and evaluated to achieve a balance between detection accuracy and computational efficiency. The proposed solution is lightweight and suitable for real-world applications such as browser extensions

title: QU ChatBot - Automated DB & AI Agent
description:
The "QU Students Chat Bot - Automated Knowledge Base & AI Assistant" is a bilingual (Arabic/English) AI-powered platform designed to resolve the fragmentation of academic information and the limitations of traditional, time-restricted student support channels at Qassim University.

Operating 24/7, the system employs a sophisticated Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture to ensure that all responses are highly accurate and strictly grounded in official university documents.

The technical stack integrates a Next.js front-end with a Docker-containerized Node.js back-end, utilizing OpenAI GPT models for natural language processing and a Pinecone vector database for rapid semantic search.

Crucially, the architecture incorporates n8n workflow automation to autonomously ingest and synchronize data updates directly from university Google Drive repositories, completely eliminating the need for manual data entry.

Engineered to maintain over 99% availability and deliver sub-3-second latency for structured queries, the project significantly reduces administrative workloads and directly supports the digital transformation and human capability development objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.

title: AI Medical Pre-Consultation System
description:
This project presents a bilingual web-based platform designed to streamline the pre-consultation process in healthcare facilities. The system bridges the gap between patients and physicians by automating data collection and providing AI-powered preliminary medical analysis before actual consultations.
System Overview:
The platform serves three distinct user roles: patients who submit their medical information, doctors who review AI-generated reports, and administrators who manage the system. Patients can complete consultation forms either through traditional text input or by using an innovative voice-based AI assistant that conducts natural conversations in both English and Arabic.
Core Functionality:
When a patient submits their symptoms and medical history, the system utilizes OpenAI's GPT-5.5 model to generate a comprehensive medical analysis including differential diagnosis, identification of potential red flags, and recommendations for initial medical workup. This preliminary analysis is then made available to the assigned physician through a dedicated dashboard, allowing them to review patient information before the actual consultation begins.
Technical Implementation:
The system is built using Next.js 15 framework with TypeScript for robust type safety and modern development practices. The frontend utilizes Tailwind CSS and Shadcn/ui components for a responsive, accessible user interface. Patient and doctor data is stored securely in a PostgreSQL database managed through Neon cloud services, with Drizzle ORM handling database operations. The AI integration leverages two OpenAI APIs: GPT-5.5 for medical analysis generation and the Realtime API for voice-based conversations. Additionally, the Web Speech API is integrated for voice input in the symptoms field.
Innovation and Impact:
The project's primary innovation lies in its voice assistant feature, which allows patients to fill out medical forms through natural conversation rather than typing. This significantly improves accessibility, especially for elderly patients or those with limited typing abilities. The bilingual support (English and Arabic) ensures the system can serve diverse populations in the region. The AI-generated preliminary diagnosis helps physicians prepare for consultations more effectively, potentially reducing consultation time and improving the quality of medical care.
User Experience:
Patients access a clean, intuitive form where they can either manually enter their information or activate the AI voice assistant. The assistant guides them through each required field conversationally, creating a more natural and less intimidating experience than traditional medical forms. Doctors receive well-organized reports with AI analysis that highlights key diagnostic considerations and recommended tests, allowing them to focus their consultation time on patient interaction rather than basic data gathering.
System Security and Privacy:
All patient data is stored securely with role-based access control ensuring that doctors can only view reports assigned to them. The system implements authentication mechanisms for both doctors and administrators, protecting sensitive medical information while maintaining ease of use.
Future Scalability:
The modular architecture allows for future enhancements such as integration with electronic health record systems, expansion to additional languages, and incorporation of more specialized medical AI models for specific conditions or medical specialties.

title: AI-Predictive Maintenance for Smart City Water Distribution Networks
description:
The project presents an AI-driven predictive maintenance system designed for smart city water distribution networks. Its main goal is to detect leaks and identify faults early, reducing water loss and improving system efficiency. The approach integrates machine learning models for two key tasks: leak detection and fault localization, supported by data collected from network sensors.

The system uses advanced techniques such as machine learning and ensemble models, combined with a structured methodology that includes data preprocessing, feature extraction, model training, and evaluation. It also incorporates a dashboard interface that visualizes system outputs, provides alerts, and supports real-time monitoring for decision-makers.

Overall, the project demonstrates how AI can enhance infrastructure reliability, optimize maintenance operations, and contribute to sustainable urban water management.

title: Logos: Intelligent Academic Assistant Based on Reasoning and Knowledge
description:
This project introduces Logos, an intelligent academic assistant developed for students at the College of Computer, Qassim University. The system provides fast and reliable access to official academic information such as regulations, course details, and graduation requirements. It is based on a multi-agent AI architecture combining semantic retrieval (FAISS) and large language models (LLaMA 3.3-70B).

The system integrates four main agents, query analysis, retrieval, evaluation, and generation, to process user queries efficiently. A curated knowledge base built from official university documents ensures accurate and trustworthy responses in both Arabic and English .

Experimental results on real student queries show strong performance, achieving 92% accuracy, 95% user satisfaction, and an average response time of 2.3 seconds. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in improving student experience and reducing information search time. Future work will extend the system’s capabilities to provide more comprehensive academic support.

title: Arabic Offline Handwritten Recognition Character Based
description:
This project investigates offline Arabic handwritten text recognition (HTR) using a character-based approach. It addresses the limitations of existing word- and line-based models, which rely heavily on contextual information and struggle to generalize across different writing styles.

Using the INF-ENIT dataset, the study compares multiple HTR approaches, including sequence-based (encoder–decoder) and detection-based models (Faster R-CNN), under a unified experimental framework. The dataset is carefully preprocessed and balanced based on character distribution to ensure fair evaluation.

The models are assessed using standard HTR metrics (CER, WAR) and character perturbation experiments to evaluate their ability to capture true character-level information. Results show that detection-based approaches better align with human reading behavior and provide improved robustness and generalization.

title: Smart Flashcard App for Personalized Learning and Retention
description:
This project is a smart flashcards learning application designed to help users study more efficiently. Traditional studying methods often require a lot of time and lead to fast forgetting, so the system uses artificial intelligence and spaced repetition to improve memory retention and learning speed.

The main idea is to convert study material into question and answer flashcards automatically, then help users review them at the right time while focusing more on weak areas.

The application is built using Flutter for the frontend, where users can enter text, upload files such as PDFs and slides, view flashcards, and take quizzes. The app uses Provider for state management to handle data and user interactions smoothly.

The backend is built using FastAPI. It receives text or uploaded files from the user, extracts content from PDFs and PowerPoint slides, and prepares the text to be processed by the AI model.

The system integrates with an AI model through the Gemini API, which generates flashcards by converting the input text into structured question and answer pairs while maintaining the same language as the original content.

All generated flashcards are stored locally on the device using Hive. Each card contains the question, answer, review timing, and difficulty level, allowing the app to work efficiently even offline.

The system works by taking user input, sending it to the backend, extracting and cleaning the text, generating flashcards using AI, and returning them to the app. The app then stores the flashcards and allows the user to study them. As the user interacts with the cards, the system tracks performance and updates difficulty levels.

The application includes features such as automatic flashcard generation, support for text and file inputs, spaced repetition, quiz mode, weak area tracking based on difficulty, deck organization, and the ability to edit or delete flashcards.

The spaced repetition system adjusts how often flashcards appear based on user performance. Cards answered correctly appear less frequently, while cards answered incorrectly appear more often, helping the user focus on weaker areas.

This project solves the problem of time-consuming manual flashcard creation and inefficient study methods. It improves memory retention, saves time, and provides a more personalized learning experience.

Overall, the project demonstrates how artificial intelligence can be combined with learning techniques to create a simple, effective, and intelligent study tool that helps users learn faster and retain information better.

title: AI-Powered Intrusion Detection System (IDS) Using Deep Learning (Project-Based)
description:
Cyber threats are growing increasingly complex, rendering traditional signature-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) ineffective against modern and zero-day attacks. This research aims to develop an intelligent, hybrid deep-learning system to detect suspicious patterns with high accuracy and provide real-time responses to both known and emerging threats.
The system utilizes an advanced preprocessing pipeline employing RobustScaler for data normalization. It also applies feature selection based on variance and correlation to effectively reduce dimensionality. The model's architecture combines CNN layers with residual connections for spatial feature extraction. This is followed by a Multi-Head Attention mechanism to focus on the most critical traffic features, and Bi-LSTM networks to analyze the temporal sequences in both directions.
The model was trained and evaluated using the realistic CICIDS2017 dataset. A sliding window technique was applied to convert network flows into time-series sequences. To address the severe class imbalance, the model was trained using a Focal Loss function and optimized using the Adam algorithm. The system demonstrated exceptional performance, achieving an overall accuracy exceeding 99% while significantly minimizing false positive rates.
The integration of attention mechanisms with hybrid neural architectures significantly enhances the reliability of threat detection. Moving beyond theoretical research, the project features a live Security Operations Center (SOC) dashboard powered by FastAPI and WebSockets. This enables the continuous monitoring of network traffic in real time, providing a practical and robust defense mechanism for enterprise environments.

title: Deep Learning for Sustainable Solar Energy Prediction
description:
The project develops a deep learning-based forecasting system for Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI), which is an important indicator of solar energy availability. The system focuses on short-term solar irradiance forecasting for the Qassim region by integrating NASA POWER satellite data with ground-based meteorological measurements from K.A.CARE. The dataset covers the period from August 2021 to August 2022.

The project applies data preprocessing, timestamp alignment, normalization, feature engineering, and 24-hour sliding-window sequence construction. Three deep learning models were developed and evaluated: LSTM, GRU, and CNN-LSTM. The models forecast GHI across three horizons: 1-hour, 3-hours, and 24-hours ahead. Model performance was evaluated using MAE, RMSE, and R².

An interactive Streamlit dashboard was also developed to visualize live forecasts, compare model performance, and present dataset insights. The project supports sustainable solar energy planning and decision-making by providing accurate multi-horizon GHI forecasts.

title: iClass
description:
iClass is a secure digital academic file management platform designed for university environments. The platform enables students to upload their study materials, such as lectures, exams, and summaries, where each file passes through a comprehensive automated processing pipeline that ensures its safety and quality before becoming accessible to other users.

When a file is uploaded, the system immediately computes a unique SHA-256 digital fingerprint to detect duplicate or blacklisted files, then compresses it using the GZIP algorithm to reduce its size, and finally encrypts it using Infisical KMS before storing it in Backblaze B2. Once these stages are complete, the file is automatically added to a smart job queue built on Bull and Redis, where the AI engine processes it asynchronously to produce short and full summaries, interactive flashcards, and automatic classifications. The file content is also converted into mathematical vector representations stored in Pinecone to enable intelligent semantic search across the platform.

The project is built on a modern architecture combining NestJS on the backend and Next.js on the frontend, backed by a PostgreSQL database managed through Prisma as the ORM layer. User identity is handled via Auth0, which issues JWT tokens that the backend verifies and uses to enforce a multi-tiered role-based access control system. This system defines four access levels: Guest, Student, Instructor, and Admin, each with specific permissions that govern what they can view or perform within the platform.

The system provides users with a rich experience that includes downloading files through secure time-limited pre-signed URLs, fifteen minutes for guests and sixty minutes for authenticated users, full-text search powered by PostgreSQL, academic content translation via DeepL, real-time notifications through WebSocket, and a comprehensive review system allowing students to rate both files and instructors.

The entire project runs inside a Docker Compose environment consisting of four integrated services: the database, Redis, the backend, and the frontend. These services communicate through a private internal network, ensuring security isolation and ease of deployment across different environments.

title: Investigating the Implementation of Artificial Intelligence Technologies in Governance: A Risk Framework
description: This thesis aimed to explore the main gaps in current artificial intelligence (AI) governance research, to determine the core components of AI security governance, to develop a risk governance framework, and to empirically test the proposed model, while assessing the explanatory and predictive importance of the studied dimensions in shaping Security and Resilience. The research targeted professionals working in information technology (IT)-related roles in Saudi Arabia, with the final analytical sample comprising 149 usable responses. A bilingual online questionnaire was used to collect data, with data analyzed using partial least squares-based structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) and artificial neural network (ANN) analysis. The findings showed that Governance Integration did not significantly influence Accountability, whereas Accountability, Governance Integration, and Bias Mitigation and Fairness significantly influenced Security and Resilience. The ANN results further showed that Accountability had the highest predictive importance. The thesis concludes that AI governance requires a more operational and cybersecurity-oriented approach within organizational environments for it to be effectively implemented.

title: Robotic Goalkeeper
description:
يهدف المشروع إلى تطوير نظام دفاعي روبوتي يعمل بشكل مستقل لرصد واعتراض الأهداف عالية السرعة في الوقت الفعلي. يعتمد النظام على وحدة معالجة Raspberry Pi 5 لضمان سرعة معالجة الفيديو بمعدل 30 إطاراً في الثانية، مع دمج نموذج تعلم عميق من نوع MobileNetV2 تم تحسينه وتدريبه على قاعدة بيانات تتجاوز 20,000  صورة لضمان دقة التصنيف في ظروف الإضاءة المختلفة والبيئات المعقدة.
يتميز النظام باستخدام خوارزمية Kalman Filter للتنبؤ بالمسار المستقبلي للكرة وتجاوز فجوة الاستجابة الميكانيكية، مما يتيح لمحركات المؤازرة (Servos) من نوع DS3225MG التحرك الاستباقي لتغطية المنطقة المستهدفة بدقة عالية وزمن تأخير (Latency) ضئيل جداً. يمثل المشروع نموذجاً متكاملاً لتطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي في الأنظمة المدمجة (Embedded Systems).

This project presents an autonomous robotic system designed for real-time detection and interception of high-speed targets. The system leverages a Raspberry Pi 5 for edge computing, processing live video at 30 FPS. A specialized MobileNetV2 deep-learning model, trained on a comprehensive dataset of 20,000+ images, provides robust object classification across varying lighting and cluttered environments.

To optimize mechanical response, a Kalman Filter is integrated for trajectory prediction, enabling high-torque DS3225MG servos to proactively secure landing zones. This integration minimizes system latency and demonstrates the effectiveness of deploying complex neural networks on portable, low-power hardware for high-speed robotic applications.

title: نظام كشف الاحتيال الصوتي باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي
description:
مشروع صون هو نظام ذكي للكشف عن الاحتيال الصوتي باستخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي، يهدف إلى حماية المستخدمين من المكالمات الاحتيالية التي تعتمد على انتحال الهوية، أساليب الإقناع الاحتيالي، أو الأصوات المولدة بالذكاء الاصطناعي. يعمل النظام على تحليل المكالمة الصوتية في الوقت الفعلي من خلال ثلاث وحدات رئيسية: تحليل نمط الكلام لاكتشاف العبارات والأساليب الاحتيالية، التحقق من البصمة الصوتية لمعرفة هوية المتحدث ومقارنتها بالبيانات المسجلة، وكشف الأصوات المزيفة أو المعدلة باستخدام نماذج متخصصة في اكتشاف التزييف الصوتي.

يركز المشروع على دعم البيئة العربية، خصوصًا المكالمات التي تحتوي على لهجات عربية أو ضوضاء أو مقاطع صوتية قصيرة، وهي من التحديات التي تواجه أنظمة الكشف التقليدية. بعد تحليل المكالمة، يقوم النظام بدمج نتائج الوحدات الثلاث وتصنيف مستوى الخطورة إلى أربع فئات: لا يوجد احتيال، منخفض، متوسط، أو عالي. وفي حال وجود اشتباه، يتم تنبيه المستخدم مباشرة أثناء المكالمة لمساعدته على اتخاذ القرار المناسب وحماية بياناته ومعلوماته الشخصية.

يتميز المشروع بأنه من أوائل الأنظمة في المنطقة العربية التي تجمع بين تحليل الكلام، البصمة الصوتية، وكشف التزييف الصوتي في نظام واحد متعدد النماذج. كما يساهم في تقليل مخاطر الاحتيال المالي وحماية المستخدمين من أساليب الاحتيال الحديثة، مع إمكانية دمجه مستقبلًا مع تطبيقات الاتصالات أو البنية التحتية لشركات الاتصالات لتعزيز الأمان الرقمي.

title: Autonomous Drone Navigation Using Computer Vision: Long-tail and Adverse Weather Scenarios.
description: Autonomous drones are increasingly employed in urban GPS-limited environments. Computer vision-based navigation offers a promising alternative but faces critical challenges in long-tail scenarios such as rare obstacles (e.g., bird strikes, thin wires) and adverse weather conditions (rain, fog, dust) that degrade visual perception. This research investigates robust navigation strategies combining deep learning  with weather processing pipelines to maintain flight safety in these edge cases.
tags: This research focuses on improving vision-based autonomous drone navigation under two difficult operating conditions: adverse weather and long-tail rare safety events. It studies how a drone can use camera images
and weather context to detect obstacles
and make safer navigation decisions when visibility is degraded or uncommon hazards appear.

title: Qiyaf
description: Qiyaf is an intelligent solar panel inspection system that utilizes Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), computer vision, and artificial intelligence to automate inspection processes and enable early defect detection. The project addresses the limitations of traditional inspection methods, which are often time-consuming and labor-intensive, by capturing solar panel video footage and analyzing it using deep learning models capable of accurately detecting defects such as cracks, dust accumulation, bird droppings, and snow coverage. The system also provides an interactive dashboard for real-time result visualization, panel condition monitoring, and maintenance decision support, contributing to improved operational efficiency and the sustainability of solar energy production.

title: LEVERAGING AI FOR ENHANCED CRIME PREVENTION AND  LAW ENFORCEMENT
description:
The research focuses on developing a system for classifying crime-related Arabic text extracted from social media platforms (such as X/Twitter) using modern Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques.

In simple terms, the study addresses the problem that large amounts of Arabic posts related to crimes are generated daily, and manually analyzing them is slow and inefficient for law enforcement agencies. Therefore, the research proposes using deep learning and transformer-based models to automatically detect and categorize these texts into predefined crime-related classes.

At the core of the methodology are Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) and Arabic-adapted variants such as AraBERT, which are fine-tuned for the classification task. These models are trained on labeled Arabic datasets after preprocessing steps such as cleaning, normalization, and tokenization.

The study includes:

- Data collection from Arabic social media text related to crime
- Preprocessing of noisy Arabic text (handling dialects)
- Model training and fine-tuning using transformer-based architectures
- Evaluation using standard metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score
- Comparison with other models and studies

The main goal of the research is to improve the detection and classification of crime-related content in Arabic, helping support faster decision-making and situational awareness in law enforcement contexts.

title: Accurate Time Series Forecasting of the Saudi Arabian Stock Market Using Hybrid Deep Learning Models
description:
Forecasting financial markets is one of the hardest problems in applied economics, and the difficulty only multiplies in volatile emerging markets. This paper takes on that challenge by forecasting the Saudi Arabian stock market index (TASI) using ten years of daily data (2014–2024), combining traditional econometric methods with state-of-the-art deep learning techniques.
Five forecasting approaches were tested — from pattern-based and volatility models to LSTM, CNN, and a hybrid CNN-LSTM. The hybrid model outperformed all others, cutting errors by over 20% compared to ARIMA while staying resilient through crises like the 2014–15 oil crash and COVID-19. This confirms that combining convolutional and recurrent layers captures both short-term shifts and long-term trends more effectively than either approach alone.
Beyond accuracy, this study makes three meaningful contributions: it applies hybrid deep learning to an underexplored market, provides a rare long-term TASI dataset, and delivers a practical forecasting tool aligned with Saudi Vision 2030's financial innovation goals — offering real value to investors and decision-makers navigating complex markets.

title: Alumni Data Management System (ADMS) for College of Computer (COC)
description:
Alumni play a vital role in supporting universities by promoting professional development, strengthening institutional networks, and enhancing communication between graduates and their universities. Despite this importance, many colleges face challenges in managing alumni data efficiently and maintaining continuous engagement with graduates after they complete their studies. This project presents an Alumni Data Management System (ADMS) developed for the College of Computer at Qassim University with the aim of improving alumni information management and facilitating effective communication between the college and its graduates.

The proposed system was designed using standard system analysis and design methodologies, including use case diagrams and data flow diagrams, to ensure a structured and user-centered solution. The system provides several essential features for administrators, such as managing alumni records, searching and filtering data, generating organized alumni information, and publishing announcements and updates. In addition, alumni users are able to access news and announcements, browse graduate profiles, and update their personal and professional information through an easy-to-use interface.

The developed system offers a reliable, secure, and user-friendly platform that enhances the efficiency of alumni data management while strengthening long-term engagement between the college and its graduates. Furthermore, the system contributes to building a connected academic and professional community that supports collaboration, networking, and future institutional development.

title: Culturally Robust Driver Drowsiness Detection
description: Drowsy driving is a major cause of road accidents because it reduces driver attention and slows reaction time. However, many existing driver-monitoring systems rely on full facial visibility or expensive hardware, making them less practical in Saudi Arabia and GCC countries, where drivers may wear niqab, hijab, shemagh, or masks. This project addresses the need for a practical and culturally adaptive drowsiness detection system. The project proposes an AI-based solution using a YOLO-based computer vision model and a mobile camera to detect visible cues such as eye closure and head movement. The system runs directly on the mobile device to preserve privacy and provides real-time audio alerts to improve driver safety.

title: Artificial Intelligence Attendance System [AIAS]
description: AIAS is an AI-powered Windows desktop application connected to a ceiling-mounted camera that captures periodic images of students during the lecture. Using YOLO for face detection and ArcFace/FaceNet for recognition, the system identifies students and updates attendance automatically throughout the session.

title: Gamified Physiotherapy: An Interactive Rehabilitation System Using AI and Motion Tracking for Brachial Plexus Injury
description:
This project developed an intelligent and interactive rehabilitation system for patients with Brachial Plexus Injuries (BPI) using Artificial Intelligence (AI), motion tracking, and gamification technologies. Patients with upper-limb injuries often undergo long and repetitive physiotherapy sessions, which can reduce motivation and adherence to rehabilitation programs. Therefore, the proposed system transforms traditional rehabilitation exercises into engaging game-based activities that improve patient participation and therapy consistency.
The system utilizes real-time body motion tracking through MediaPipe technology to detect body landmarks, calculate joint angles, and measure the patient’s Range of Motion (ROM) during rehabilitation sessions. It also includes adaptive rehabilitation games that automatically adjust exercise difficulty based on the patient’s performance and progress.
In addition, the system provides a comprehensive medical dashboard that enables physiotherapists to monitor patient progress, analyze historical performance data, evaluate rehabilitation outcomes, and make data-driven clinical decisions. The project was developed using an iterative development methodology that involved continuous design, implementation, testing, and refinement with feedback from physiotherapists.
Although the system was primarily designed for patients with Brachial Plexus Injuries, it also demonstrated the potential to support rehabilitation for other conditions such as Stroke, Cerebral Palsy, and post-surgical recovery cases.

title: INTERACTIVE INDOOR WAYFINDING AND NAVIGATION KIOSK SYSTEM
description:
The project is a flexible and highly customizable Smart Indoor Navigation System designed to guide visitors, and staff through complex buildings and facilities (such as hospitals, airports, shopping malls, and academic or governmental institutions) using the shortest and most accurate routes.

The system has been successfully developed and deployed as a "Proof of Concept" (PoC) within our college building, validating its high scalability and seamless adaptability to any other indoor environment simply by updating its database. Operating as an Interactive Kiosk powered by a Raspberry Pi, the system features dynamic, visually clear digital map generation. The core software relies on advanced pathfinding algorithms based on Graph Theory, alongside a robust SQLite database and a responsive UI. This makes the project an innovative, market-ready technical solution that actively contributes to transforming traditional facilities into smart buildings.

المشروع عبارة عن نظام ملاحة داخلي ذكي (Smart Indoor Navigation System) مرن وقابل للتخصيص، يهدف إلى إرشاد الزوار والمستخدمين داخل المباني والمنشآت المعقدة (مثل المستشفيات، المطارات، المراكز التجارية، والقطاعات الحكومية أو الأكاديمية) بأقصر الطرق وأكثرها دقة.

تم بناء وتطبيق النظام بنجاح كـ "إثبات مفهوم" (Proof of Concept) داخل مبنى الكلية، مما يؤكد قابليته العالية للتوسع (Scalability) وإمكانية استنساخه وتطبيقه في أي بيئة داخلية أخرى بمجرد تحديث قاعدة البيانات. يعمل النظام كمنصة استعلام تفاعلية (Interactive Kiosk) مدعومة بمعالج (Raspberry Pi)، ويتميز بتوليد خرائط رقمية ديناميكية وواضحة بصرياً. يعتمد النظام برمجياً على خوارزميات تحديد المسار (Pathfinding Algorithms) المبنية على نظرية المخططات (Graph Theory)، مما يجعله حلاً تقنياً مبتكراً وقابلاً للتسويق يساهم في تحويل المباني التقليدية إلى بيئات ومبانٍ ذكية.

title: Explainable AI-based Deep Learning Techniques for Breast Cancer Detection
description:
Breast cancer is a leading cause of death among women worldwide, 
making early detection critical. Traditional methods like mammography
face limitations in accuracy and interpretation. This research proposes a deep learning framework using pretrained CNNs,
CLAHE preprocessing, transfer learning, and Grad-CAM explainability to classify mammogram images as benign or
malignant and assign standardized BI-RADS labels. The system is evaluated using accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, 
precision, recall, and AUC.

title: Device-Bound OTP Authentication (Waqaa)
description:
Waqaa is a smart security system that adds an extra layer of protection to applications such as banks or digital services.
Instead of relying only on SMS verification codes, Waqaa confirms important actions using the user’s trusted personal device. When a sensitive action happens — like transferring money or approving access — the system quietly checks whether the request is really coming from the trusted device linked to the user.
The user continues using the main application normally, while Waqaa works in the background to help prevent fraud, stolen accounts, and fake verification attempts.

title: EmpathyBot: AI-Powered Mental Health Companion for Personalized Emotional Support
description:
EmpathyBot is an AI-powered mental health companion that uses real-time emotion detection and crisis management to make psychological support accessible to everyone.
The system is built on a RoBERTa-Large model (355M parameters) fine-tuned on the GoEmotions dataset across 28 emotion categories. Training utilized Weighted Focal Loss, AdamW optimizer with layer-wise learning rate decay, and Multi-Sample Dropout — achieving competitive Macro-F1 scores that surpass several existing studies in emotion classification.

title: Clauto - Classroom Automatic Attendance System
description: Traditional classroom management relies heavily on manual procedures that are inefficient, error-prone, and energy-wasteful. Instructors manually activate equipment, attendance is recorded by hand, and scheduling conflicts arise from disconnected systems. CLAUTO addresses these challenges by integrating IoT automation, digital attendance tracking, and classroom reservation into a single unified platform  transforming standard university classrooms into smart, connected environments.

title: معيار
description:
The Miyar project is an interactive employee performance management platform that records every task completed by employees and allows managers to select evaluation criteria such as work quality, deadline adherence, teamwork, and organization. The platform leverages artificial intelligence to analyze task performance, deadline compliance, and overall efficiency, providing accurate and continuously updated ratings on a five-point scale.
The platform generates automatic, real-time reports that save time for both employees and managers. It also facilitates task assignment and enables easy tracking of task statuses, including completed, pending, and urgent tasks. Additionally, Miyar incorporates motivational elements such as experience points and badges to enhance employee engagement and motivation.
The primary goal of Miyar is to simplify employee performance tracking and deliver objective, fair evaluations that support professional growth, boost productivity, and foster mutual trust between employees and management.

title: AI-Powered Personal Hajj E-Guide
description: Millions of Muslims perform Hajj annually, yet existing digital solutions remain fragmented, connectivity dependent, and not pilgrim centric leaving individuals without personalized guidance or reliable offline support. Unlike current apps, this project uniquely combines Al-powered ritual guidance, offline geofencing, and hybrid positioning into a single intelligent companion that functions without internet connectivity.

title: EagleEye: AI-Powered Detection of Small Objects in UAV Footage
description: EagleEye is an AI-powered system designed to detect small targets in UAV footage. title: Dhallah App - تطبيق ضاله
description:
Dhallah App – The Smart Solution for Lost & Found
About the Project:
Dhallah is an innovative Saudi platform that leverages Artificial Intelligence to streamline the process of finding lost items and returning them to their rightful owners across the Kingdom. The project aims to replace traditional methods (such as social media posts) with a smart, automated system that connects finders and owners instantly and accurately.
How It Works:
The app utilizes advanced Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing (NLP) algorithms to analyze images and descriptions provided in reports. Once a "Lost" report and a "Found" report are submitted, the system automatically matches them and sends an instant notification if a high similarity is detected, eliminating the need for manual searching.
Key Features:
• AI-Powered Matching: A sophisticated search engine that matches images and descriptions with high precision.
• Match-Based Secure Chat: An instant messaging system that is only activated when a match is confirmed. This ensures secure, direct communication with the relevant person and prevents spam or unsolicited messages.
• Interactive Mapping: Precise geolocation of where items were lost or found to narrow down the search area and facilitate recovery.
• User-Friendly Interface: A seamless experience that allows users to submit reports in seconds through simple, intuitive steps.
• Kingdom-Wide Coverage: A unified platform serving all cities and regions across Saudi Arabia.
Project Goal:
To harness cutting-edge AI technology to save time and effort in recovering personal belongings while ensuring the highest levels of privacy, and promoting the values of honesty and initiative within the Saudi community.

title: An Integrated Platform for Digital Invoicing  and Receipt  Management in Retail Transaction  Systems :  WaslTech
description:
WaslTech is a smart digital invoicing platform designed to transform traditional paper-based receipt systems into a secure, scalable, and user-centric digital solution. The platform integrates directly with point-of-sale (POS) systems, enabling real-time transmission of invoice data to a cloud-based backend, where digital invoices are generated, validated, and stored. A unique QR code is then created and displayed at the point of sale, allowing customers to instantly access and save their receipts without requiring personal contact information.

The system provides users with a unified digital wallet to manage and organize receipts across multiple merchants, supporting key functionalities such as invoice retrieval, warranty tracking, return reminders, and loyalty point accumulation. In addition, WaslTech enhances the post-purchase experience by offering AI-powered spending analysis and personalized insights, enabling users to better understand their financial behavior and make informed decisions.

By reducing reliance on paper receipts, the platform minimizes operational costs for businesses, improves transaction efficiency, and contributes to environmental sustainability. WaslTech aligns with Saudi Arabia’s digital transformation goals and Vision 2030 by delivering a modern, compliant, and innovative approach to invoice management.

title: ASSAS-AI Driven Road Damage Detection, Prioritization, and Prediction System
description:
ASSAS is an AI-driven intelligent system designed to enhance road infrastructure management in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia through automated damage detection, prioritization, and prediction of road conditions. The system is based on municipal vehicles equipped with cameras that continuously capture road conditions along with determining their geographic locations.

The system utilizes computer vision techniques based on YOLOv8m (Deep Learning) to detect multiple types of road damage, including potholes, cracks, water accumulation, and normal road conditions. One of the key strengths of the system is its ability to distinguish between damaged and non-damaged (normal) roads, which enhances detection reliability and reduces false positives. The system achieved 90.6% mAP detection performance using a dataset exceeding 23,000 road images. The system is also capable of analyzing multiple damages within a single image and identifying the most critical condition to support decision-making.

After detecting the damage, the system determines maintenance priority based on the severity level and type of damage, then generates a prediction of the road condition to support proactive maintenance and efficient resource management.

The system is integrated with an interactive dashboard that enables ASSAS employees to upload reports, specify locations on the map, assign cases to engineers, and monitor case status in real time. Engineers can manage assigned cases, update repair progress, and upload post-repair images. All cases are visualized on a map using color-coded indicators reflecting severity levels, alongside a structured table of reports and detailed case views, providing a comprehensive and efficient monitoring environment.

ASSAS contributes to improving operational efficiency, reducing maintenance costs, enhancing road safety, and supporting data-driven decision-making, while aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 toward smarter cities and more advanced and sustainable infrastructure.

title: WATHEEQ: An AI-Powered Platform for Automated Cybersecurity Compliance Assessment Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
description:
WATHEEQ is an intelligent cybersecurity compliance platform designed to automate the assessment of organizational policies and security documents against regulatory cybersecurity frameworks such as NCA NCS, ECC, and SAMA CSF.

The platform utilizes Artificial Intelligence and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to semantically analyze documents, retrieve relevant regulatory controls, and generate automated compliance reports with identified gaps, recommendations, and compliance scores.

WATHEEQ combines hybrid retrieval techniques, including semantic vector search and keyword-based retrieval, with advanced reranking models to improve accuracy and contextual understanding. The system significantly reduces manual auditing effort, accelerates compliance readiness, and provides scalable AI-driven cybersecurity compliance analysis.

title: A Transformer-based Framework for Video Anomaly Detection
description:
The project aims to build an intelligent system for automatically detecting abnormal behaviors in surveillance videos, such as fighting, falling, throwing objects, and walking in the wrong direction. The team adopted a One-Class Learning approach, where the model is trained on normal behavior only, and any behavior that differs from what it has learned is automatically classified as anomalous. This approach was chosen because abnormal behavior is rare and it is difficult to collect all its types, so instead of teaching the model every possible anomaly, it is sufficient to teach it normal behavior only.
To implement this idea, the Avenue Dataset was used, consisting of 37 video clips divided into 16 for training and 21 for testing at 25 frames per second. It was selected for being balanced, realistic, and widely used in research, which facilitates comparison with previous works.
The project is distinguished by using two types of input data: RGB features representing the visual appearance of the scene, and Pose information representing human body movement through joint keypoints such as the head, hands, and legs. Combining both provides the model with a deeper and more accurate understanding of behavior. The model relies on Vision Transformer to understand the appearance within each frame, and Temporal Transformer to understand motion and change over time, both built on Self-Attention and FFN. The tools used are Python for data preparation and PyTorch for building and training the model. Finally, the model will be evaluated using Frame-level AUC and Equal Error Rate to verify its ability to distinguish between normal and abnormal events.

title: Dynamic Portfolio Optimization in the Saudi Stock Market: An RL Approach Leveraging LLM Sentiment and GRU Forecasting Signals
description:
The increasing complexity of financial markets, fueled by rapid data growth and
global economic shifts, has intensified the need for advanced portfolio
optimization that balances risk and return. While traditional trading relies on
numerical data, qualitative news sentiment is now recognized as a vital driver of
market dynamics.
Despite the Saudi Stock Exchange (Tadawul) being the largest in the Middle East,
there is a significant research gap in integrating modern AI-driven strategies within
this specific market. This study addresses this by developing a framework that
leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) for sentiment extraction, Gated
Recurrent Units (GRU) for return forecasting, and Reinforcement Learning (RL)
for adaptive decision-making.
Main Objectives:
Develop an RL Framework: Build a framework for dynamic portfolio
optimization and adaptive trading for the Saudi stock market.
Signal Integration: Combine GRU-based forecasting and LLM-based
sentiment analysis to enhance market awareness and portfolio allocation.
Performance Evaluation: Analyze the impact of these integrated signals on
trading performance against baseline portfolio strategies.
Behavioral Analysis: Analyze the agent’s behavior across different market
regimes to assess its adaptability and decision-making patterns under varying
market conditions.
Ablation Analysis: Evaluate each signal’s contribution and test whether LLM
sentiment and GRU predictions are more effective as observations or reward
components.

تتيح المنصة لأصحاب العقارات إضافة وإدارة الإعلانات العقارية، بينما يمكن للمستخدمين البحث عن العقارات المناسبة باستخدام خيارات تصفية متعددة وعرض تفاصيل العقار بسهولة. كما توفر المنصة لوحة تحكم للمشرف لإدارة المستخدمين والتحقق من الإعلانات لضمان دقة المعلومات وموثوقيتها.

title: Smart Oasis
description:
The palm tree sector faces significant challenges due to the slow and often inaccurate nature of traditional manual inspection. "Smart Oasis" addresses this by providing an advanced technical solution that automates the diagnosis of palm tree diseases using a sophisticated triple-model Deep Learning framework.
The Three Core Components:
1.	Detection & Verification: An initial AI model designed to accurately identify and verify palm trees from field images.
2.	Disease Analysis & Diagnosis: A specialized deep learning engine that analyzes leaf patterns to classify specific diseases with high precision (achieving up to 96% accuracy).
3.	Expert AI Consultant: An integrated RAG-based Chatbot that provides real-time agricultural consultations and treatment recommendations based on verified project research.

title: Brain Tumour Classification using machine learning and deep learning
description: A brain tumor is an abnormal growth of cells in the brain, and accurate" classification is essential for clinical diagnosis. This project utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Deep Learning (DL) to enhance precision and accelerate the detection process using MRI images. The study luated multiple models, including ResNet50, EfficientNet-BO, and VGGB, where ResNet50 achieved the highest overall accuracy of 97.73%.

title: AI-Powered Analysis of Tourists’ Opinions on Saudi Attractions
description: This project proposes an AI-based approach to analyse tourist opinions on Saudi attractions using NLP and sentiment analysis. Bilingual data from different platforms will be processed using transform models to classify opinions into positive, negative, and neutral sentiments, supporting tourism improvement and data-driven decision-making.
